text: {"lessons":["Short-term gains and losses have not shown me a reliable way to predict next month’s prices, so I won’t trade based on recent moves.","I’ll set clear reasons and limits for each position in advance, rather than holding a losing stock just to avoid admitting a mistake or selling a winner just for the satisfaction of locking in a gain.","I’ve made no trades so far; I’ll avoid reacting to every account fluctuation and review my portfolio periodically against my long-term plan."]}
